title: Grilled Arabian Shrimp Skewers with Myeongnan Roe
description: A flavorful and healthy dish that combines the richness of Myeongnan roe with the spiciness of Arabian spices, served with crispy shrimp skewers.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together Arabian Spice Blend and lemon juice.
3. Add shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
4. Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the skewers with olive oil.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
7. If using Myeongnan roe, sprinkle it over the skewers during the last minute of grilling.
